refuter_findings.evidence: The prescribed response applies to every complex amplitude e and real frequency omega, but no reality symmetry is imposed on chi. The admissible function chi(z)=i satisfies all stated analytic hypotheses with n=1. For e=E_*e_1 and frequencies +omega_* and -omega_*, the input history is the same E_*cos(omega_*t)e_1, while the prescribed responses are respectively +epsilon_0 E_*sin(omega_*t)e_1 and -epsilon_0 E_*sin(omega_*t)e_1. Thus the rule does not define a response from the real field history independently of its representation. The all-real-frequency convention needs chi(-omega)=conjugate(chi(omega)), including real chi(0), or an explicitly restricted representation domain.
